apiKey.title: SMTPing API key
apiKey.description: Your API key from smtping.com (Dashboard > API). Every account gets 25 free credits per day, no card required.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: One address per line. Duplicates and malformed lines are removed.

fileUrl.title: List URL (CSV or TXT)
fileUrl.description: Optional public URL of a CSV or TXT file. Every email address found in it is verified.

outputFilter.title: Rows to keep in the dataset
outputFilter.description: safe = valid and alias only. safe_judgement also keeps catchall, valid_catchall and unknown. all keeps everything, including do_not_send rows.

bulkThreshold.title: Bulk threshold
bulkThreshold.description: Lists at or above this size use one bulk job instead of single calls.

concurrency.title: Concurrency (single mode)
concurrency.description: Parallel single verifications for small lists.
